newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Export bank fund fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Export bank fund fully subscribed.

text.p: Export Development Bank of Egypt said on Sunday its mutual fund had been fully subscribed at 100 million pounds.
The fund, the 11th launched in Egypt in less than three years, opened for subscriptions on August 6 and could have closed 15 days later if fully subscribed at that stage.

An official at the bank said that by the closing date, October 6, it had received applications for units worth 114 million pounds and some investors then reduced the size of their applications to make exactly 100 million pounds.
The fund, described as an open-ended equities-based growth and income fund, will pay dividends every six months.
The other 10 funds have a total market value of more than 1.7 billion pounds and have generated returns of between 12.1 and 68.5 percent since the start of 1996.
